operational_definition: At least one exact training-demo fit found within the frozen representation/inference/order and that mode's finite candidate budget
scope_and_limit: Bounded operational found-fit only; no fit is not proof of semantic unrepresentability

operational_definition: One structured search trace emitted for each task and mode including no-fit attempts
scope_and_limit: 100 percent is mechanical trace emission and not successful reasoning

operational_definition: Emitted trace independently validates and its selected candidate exactly replays every training demonstration
scope_and_limit: Success is demo-fit only; no test outputs or accuracy

operational_definition: Actual Phase 13G TraceMiner emits a mapped invariant from successful discovery traces under frozen support 5 and consistency 1.0
measurement_unit: task ID; candidate support counted by distinct discovery trace
scope_and_limit: Budgeted support: reflect_vertical=1; fullscan support: three distinct programs at 1 each; threshold not met

operational_definition: Skill candidate exists after invariant availability and required frozen lifecycle gates
scope_and_limit: No C4 candidate exists; skill-building/transfer qualification not invoked

operational_definition: Task has an available skill candidate that can be assessed under a separate transfer protocol without using accuracy as coverage
scope_and_limit: No skill candidate; conditional denominator is zero and rate is not estimable

operational_definition: At least two validated reusable skills and qualifying transfer evidence are available
scope_and_limit: No skill or transfer pool; capability formation not tested
